data_description.pairing_instructions_generic:
1. Put your bed in pairing mode (hold lamp button until blue light blinks, or unplug for 30+ seconds)
2. Click 'Pair Now'
data_description.pairing_instructions_okin:
1. Put the OKIN base into Bluetooth pairing mode by power-cycling the control box: unplug it for ~30 seconds, then plug it back in. The status light blinks blue, then turns green after ~20 seconds. (Some models instead use the under-bed lamp/light button - hold it until the light blinks blue.) There is no separate Bluetooth pairing button; any Pair/Learn button on the box only syncs the RF remote.
2. While the light is active, click 'Pair Now'.
data_description.pairing_instructions_sleep_number:
1. Put your bed in pairing mode (hold the side pairing button until the blue light blinks)
2. Click 'Pair Now'
data_description.pairing_instructions_leggett_gen2:
1. Unplug your bed's power cord and remove any batteries from the power supply.
2. Plug the bed back in. Wait for a small chime and a pulsing blue light under the bed.
3. While the light is pulsing, promptly click 'Pair Now'.

❌ The bed connected through Bluetooth proxy **{transport}**, but authentication failed. Close the bed's phone app, put the bed back into Bluetooth pairing mode, and select **Try again** using the same proxy.

reverie_family.title: Which Reverie receiver is in this bed?
reverie_family.description:
Reverie beds use one of two receivers. If you use the Reverie Nightstand app, choose the Nightstand receiver. If you use the older Reverie app, choose the older receiver. Home Assistant could not tell which one this bed has.

sleep_number_family.title: Which Sleep Number base is this?
sleep_number_family.description:
Sleep Number bases use one of two control boxes. Climate 360, FlexFit and FlexFit Smart bases are Fuzion bases. Older i8 and 360 FlexFit 2 bases use the older box. Home Assistant could not tell which one this bed has.

Not sure? Choose the box that matches your base's model, then check that the bed responds.

limoss_family.title: Which app controls this Limoss receiver?
limoss_family.description: Limoss Remote, FSM Relax and the older Limoss controls share the receiver's Bluetooth name and service, so the name doesn't choose one. Choose the app you use on your phone, or the older controls if you use none. Each has its own controls and memory format, and none is translated into another.

malouf_family.title: Which app or receiver controls this bed?
malouf_family.description: The Malouf Base and Lucid Base apps and the remotes send different commands, and the model name doesn't tell them apart. Choose the app you use on your phone, or the remote if you don't use an app. Current or detected setup: **{current}**.

jensen_family.title: Which app and bed is this?
jensen_family.description: The Jensen Adjustable Sleep app and the Svane Remote app send different commands, and both work with the same beds. Choose the app you use on your phone and the bed it controls. The suggestion follows the apps' own name rules. A LinON Entry box is JMC400 hardware, not the LinOn bed.

richmat_family.title: Which Richmat app controls this bed?
richmat_family.description: Richmat apps share the bed's Bluetooth names and services, so the name doesn't choose one. Choose the app you use on your phone. Without one of these apps, choose the Richmat remote controls.

estimate_flat.title: Calibrate {motor}
estimate_flat.description:
Step {step} of {steps}, {motor}.

The {motor} must be fully lowered before it is measured. Lower it with the card or the remote, or let this step lower it. Only you can confirm that it is fully lowered.

menu_options.estimate_flat_confirm: It is fully lowered, raise it now

estimate_lowering.title: Lowering {motor}
estimate_lowering.description: The {motor} is moving down. Select **It is fully lowered now** once it has stopped moving. Movement stops by itself after {max_s} s.

estimate_raise.title: Calibrate {motor}
estimate_raise.description:
Step {step} of {steps}, {motor}.

The {motor} is moving up from fully lowered. Select **Reached the top** the moment it stops moving.

The time runs from the first movement command. Movement stops by itself after {max_s} s if you do nothing. Tapping adds a small delay; you can fine tune the times on the last step.

menu_options.estimate_cancel: Stop, something is wrong. Nothing is saved

estimate_lower.title: Calibrate {motor}
estimate_lower.description:
Step {step} of {steps}, {motor}.

The {motor} is moving down. Select **Reached the bottom** the moment it stops moving. Movement stops by itself after {max_s} s if you do nothing.

menu_options.estimate_cancel: Stop, something is wrong. Nothing is saved

estimate_retry.title: {motor} was not measured
estimate_retry.description: The movement was not timed. It may not have started yet, it may have reached the {max_s} s safety stop first, or it failed. The {motor} has been stopped.

estimate_review.title: Review calibration
estimate_review.description:
Step {step} of {steps}.

The seconds each motor takes for its full travel. Adjust them to fine tune, or type them if you timed the bed with a stopwatch. Motors you just measured ended fully lowered, so their reference is set and they start at 0%. Times can be measured again any time from this menu; changing them keeps your saved positions.

confirm.title: Pair your adjustable bed
confirm.description:
**{name}** ({address}) needs a Bluetooth bond before it can be controlled.

1. Put the bed into pairing mode. Most OKIN bases (Okimat, Rize, Jordan's, Nectar, Mattress Firm 900-O): unplug the control box for 30 seconds, then plug it back in. Leggett & Platt Smart Bed: unplug the bed and take the batteries out of the power supply, then plug it back in and wait for the chime and the pulsing blue light. Other beds: hold the pairing button on the control box or remote until its light blinks.
2. While the bed is in pairing mode, select **Submit**.
3. If pairing keeps failing, remove the old pairing and try again. On a Home Assistant host, run `bluetoothctl remove {address}`. Through an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, the pairing is stored on the proxy, so clear it there. One common cause is an old pairing that no longer matches.

Pairing happens on Home Assistant or its Bluetooth proxy, not on your phone. ESPHome proxies need ESPHome 2024.3.0 or newer.

proxy_pairing.title: Pair your bed through the Bluetooth proxy
proxy_pairing.description:
**{name}** ({address}) connected through Bluetooth proxy **{transport}**, but authentication failed. The bed may need pairing, or saved pairing keys may no longer match.

1. Close the bed's phone app and keep the proxy near the bed.
2. Put the bed into **Bluetooth pairing mode**, following its manufacturer's instructions. For Sleep Number Climate 360 / FlexFit Fuzion, hold the side pairing button until the blue light blinks.
3. Select **Submit** to try pairing again through the bed's configured Bluetooth path. Keep using the same proxy.

If the **same authentication error** returns, follow the [step-by-step proxy recovery guide]({recovery_url}). It explains how to save your proxy configuration, connect it by USB, fully erase its flash, reinstall its original configuration, and pair again. A normal wireless firmware update does **not** erase saved pairing keys.

**A full erase is a last resort:** it removes the proxy's Wi-Fi settings and **all Bluetooth pairings**, including other devices. This repair does not erase anything automatically. Timeouts or missing Bluetooth services alone are not a reason to erase the proxy.

stale_bond_confirm.title: Replace a bond the bed no longer accepts
stale_bond_confirm.description:
**{name}** ({address}) connects, but every encrypted read is refused. That is what happens when this host still holds a Bluetooth bond the bed itself has forgotten, usually after the bed was reset or paired with something else.

**Bond stored on:** {transport}

Continuing removes that bond and creates a new one. Home Assistant checks the bed is reachable before removing anything, so a sleeping bed will not be left without a bond, and the new bond is only recorded once it has been confirmed to work.

Put the bed into pairing mode, then select **Submit**.

abort.pairing_failed: Pairing didn't finish. Put the bed back into pairing mode, check that it is in range of your Bluetooth adapter or proxy, then run this repair again. If it keeps failing, remove the old pairing on the adapter or proxy and try again.

If pairing through that proxy still fails, follow the [proxy recovery guide]({recovery_url}).
